_note: Single source for every page's head: title, meta description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter card and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (tools/seo.mjs, run by sync-shell). 'staging': true forces noindex,nofollow everywhere; set it to false at launch and the per-page 'robots' values (the matrix in docs/content/seo-guide.md section 4) take effect. 'content' reads the title and description from the docs/content front matter; 'intro' from docs/content/category-and-age-intros.md. 'path' is the Laravel route (the canonical is site.url + path), not the prototype file name. category.html and product.html are one sample each: proto-listing.js and product.js apply the same rules per state, and the Blade views build them per record (docs/backend-contract.md, 'SEO needs from the backend'). Pages without a 'crumbs' trail get no BreadcrumbList.

shop.html.title: Baby Clothes Online in Sri Lanka | Kayaa
shop.html.description: Shop soft baby clothing from Newborn to 3Y. Clear size guide, secure card payment and island-wide delivery across Sri Lanka.

categories.html.title: Shop Baby Clothes by Category | Kayaa
categories.html.description: Browse Kayaa baby clothing by type: newborn, bodysuits, sleepwear, sets, outerwear, napkins and accessories, with island-wide delivery.

product.html.title: Ribbed Cotton Bodysuit | Baby Bodysuits | Kayaa
product.html.description: A soft everyday bodysuit with a ribbed finish and easy snap closures at the shoulder and bottom, made to be worn on its own or layered.

search.html.title: Search Kayaa | Baby Clothes
search.html.description: Search Kayaa baby clothing by name or type. Find bodysuits, sleepwear, sets, outerwear and accessories with island-wide delivery in Sri Lanka.

cart.html.title: Your Bag | Kayaa
cart.html.description: Review the items in your Kayaa bag, see your delivery fee and free-delivery progress, then continue to secure checkout with card payment.

checkout.html.title: Secure Checkout | Kayaa
checkout.html.description: Enter your delivery details and pay securely by card to place your Kayaa order. We show your delivery estimate before you pay.

thank-you.html.title: Order Confirmed | Kayaa
thank-you.html.description: Your Kayaa order confirmation, with your order number, items, delivery details and payment status. Keep your order number to track it.

track.html.title: Track Your Order | Kayaa
track.html.description: Find your Kayaa order with your order number and the mobile number you used at checkout to see its status, payment status and delivery estimate.

wishlist.html.title: Your Wishlist | Kayaa
wishlist.html.description: The Kayaa baby clothes you saved for later. Remove a product, or choose a size and add it to your bag when you are ready to order.

contact.html.title: Contact Kayaa | WhatsApp, Email & Messages
contact.html.description: Questions about sizing, delivery or an order? Message Kayaa on WhatsApp, email us or use the contact form. We reply Monday to Saturday.

account/login.html.title: Sign In | Kayaa
account/login.html.description: Sign in to your Kayaa account to see your orders and reviews. You can also order and track as a guest, with no account needed.

account/register.html.title: Create an Account | Kayaa
account/register.html.description: Create a Kayaa account to keep your orders and reviews in one place. An account is optional: guest checkout and order tracking always work.

account/forgot-password.html.title: Forgot Your Password? | Kayaa
account/forgot-password.html.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new Kayaa password, if that email is registered with an account.

account/reset-password.html.title: Reset Your Password | Kayaa
account/reset-password.html.description: Choose a new password for your Kayaa account. Use at least 8 characters, then sign in with your new password to see your orders.

account/verify-email.html.title: Verify Your Email | Kayaa
account/verify-email.html.description: Verify your email address to see the orders you placed as a guest with that email in your Kayaa account. Resend the link if needed.

account/index.html.title: My Orders | Kayaa
account/index.html.description: Your Kayaa orders in one place, with their status and payment status. Open an order to track it, resume payment or write a review.

account/order.html.title: Order Details | Kayaa
account/order.html.description: The items, totals, delivery details and status of one Kayaa order, with links to track it, resume payment or cancel while it is pending.

account/reviews.html.title: My Reviews | Kayaa
account/reviews.html.description: The reviews you wrote for Kayaa products, with their status. Reviews are checked by us before they appear on the product page.

account/profile.html.title: Your Profile | Kayaa
account/profile.html.description: Update your name, email and mobile number, or change your password. Your details are used for your orders and your Kayaa account.

404.html.title: Page Not Found | Kayaa
404.html.description: We could not find that page. Search Kayaa, browse the categories or head back to the shop to find soft baby clothing for newborns.

419.html.title: Page Expired | Kayaa
419.html.description: For your security the page timed out. Go back and try again, or return to the Kayaa home page to keep shopping for baby clothes.

429.html.title: Too Many Attempts | Kayaa
429.html.description: There were too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again, or contact Kayaa if you need a hand with an order.

500.html.title: Something Went Wrong | Kayaa
500.html.description: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment, or message Kayaa on WhatsApp if you need help with an order.

503.html.title: We'll Be Right Back | Kayaa
503.html.description: Kayaa is making a quick update. Please check back soon, or email us if you need help with an order while the site is unavailable.
